requestSettings.timeout: Label of the field for the time limit of a request, in milliseconds.
requestSettings.timeoutPlaceholder: {{milliseconds}} is the default time limit in milliseconds.
requestSettings.verifyTls: Checkbox label. TLS certificates are the certificates of HTTPS servers.
requestSettings.sendCookies: Checkbox label. The cookie jar is the store of saved cookies.
requestSettings.tags: Label of the field for tags: short words used to group and filter requests.
requestSettings.tagsPlaceholder: Example tags separated by commas. Replace with natural examples in your language.
requestSettings.description: Label of the free text field that documents a request.
